remarks: Welcome to this charming 1926 Colonial conveniently located in the heart of mid-city. The inviting enclosed porch welcomes you to a living room adorned with a wood-burning fireplace and a spacious dining area, creating the perfect backdrop for entertaining and cherished family gatherings. The kitchen, complete with pantry and breakfast nook provides a place for everyone. Also on the first floor is a half bath and enclosed porch (that needs a little work) overlooking the fenced in backyard. Upstairs there are 3 bedrooms and a full bath. This home is centrally located near everything! It's on the bus line, near Merritt parkway and I-95, train station, down the street from shopping and parks and close to vibrant downtown Stamford with all it has to offer. With a little work you can make this house and home!
